name: Studio design system + Draft Angle Analysis
highlights: A new Studio design system restyles every surface from one token set — glass top bar, hero start screen with six capability tiles, refined tree, panels, menus and navigation — with the Inter typeface embedded so the interface looks the same on Windows, macOS and Linux
Display → Dark frame (Graphite) turns the frame dark while every tool panel and evidence card stays white; the choice is remembered locally and applied before first paint
The AI Engineer, Photoreal, Support us and ProReadyEngineer buttons stay visible with text labels from 1280 px up (measured 1280–2560 px)

Inspect → Draft Angle Analysis classifies every CAD face as positive, negative, requires-draft or straddling for one pull direction and required angle, colors them in the viewport (clipped by the section plane) and exports a full audit CSV
Every STEP assembly imports on a pool of CAD kernels sized to your machine (up to 12) — a 40 MB, 189-part truck opens in 13 s instead of 51 s on a 32-thread workstation
